Aurora Biotech Global Limited Annual Report FY 2031
Aurora Biotech reported total consolidated revenue of 842.5 million credits for FY 2031.
In November 2031, Phase III trials for the neuro-regenerative compound ABX-99 achieved a 94.2% primary efficacy rate.

Helios Space Propulsion Corporation Financial Review 2031
Helios completed static fire testing of the ion-thruster engine H-700 with a total fuel efficiency of 98.4%.
The Research & Development expenditure for the ion thruster project was capitalized at 112.4 million credits.
